description: Search nice to have, a shelf of ready-made build kits for Claude Code and Codex (step-by-step recipes with fixes for pitfalls found in real work). Use this whenever the user wants to make or build something — slides/decks, LINE stickers, pixel-art sprite animation, 3D/AR models from product photos, YouTube Playables games, pet names and more — to check whether a kit already exists before starting from scratch. Works in Japanese or English (例: 「スライドを作りたい」「LINEスタンプ」「ゲームをYouTubeに出したい」).

lang.description: Language for the answer. Defaults to the language of the query.

query.description: What the user wants to make, in their own words (Japanese or English).
